question: A cylindrical hole with the radius of its base given as 3.5 cm is made in a solid cube each of whose edge is 14 cm. Find the total surface area (in cm²) of the cube with the hole. [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a hole is drilled completely through a solid, the net Total Surface Area (TSA) is:

Net TSA = (TSA of Cube) − (2 × Base Area of Hole) + (Curved Surface Area of Hole)

Net TSA = 6a² − 2πr² + 2πrh

Net TSA = 6 × 14² − 2 × (22/7) × (3.5)² + 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 14

Net TSA = 1176 − 77 + 308 = 1407 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1407 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36df7fc9c35924b495f9b50ea80c21a79e05982892863208a5f0c7f4e4012259.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Edge of the solid cube (a) = 14 cm

⇒ Radius of the cylindrical hole (r) = 3.5 cm

⇒ Height of the cylindrical hole (h) = Edge of cube = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = (TSA of solid cube) − (2 × Area of circular bases of hole) + (CSA of cylindrical hole)

⇒ TSA = 6a² − 2πr² + 2πrh

**Calculations:**

⇒ TSA of cube = 6 × 14 × 14 = 6 × 196 = 1176 cm²

⇒ Area of 2 circular bases = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5 = 77 cm²

⇒ CSA of cylindrical hole = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 14 = 308 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 1176 − 77 + 308 = 1407 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1407 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effect of Drilling a Hole on Surface Area

When a hole is drilled completely through a solid, the flat surface area corresponding to the base cuts is lost, but the newly created inner curved surface is exposed and must be added to the total area.

Important Formulas for a Cube

Volume = a³ | Total Surface Area = 6a² | Length of Body Diagonal = a√3.

Important Formulas for a Cylinder

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area = 2πrh | Total Surface Area = 2πr(r + h).
